---
name: minimal
description: Make the smallest possible targeted change.
argument-hint: Describe the tiny change needed (type fix, spacing change, prop rename, text update, etc.)
agent: agent
---

Treat the rest of the chat message as a request for the smallest possible change.

Apply **Minimal mode** from the repository instructions.

Priorities:
1. Do the least invasive change that solves the request.
2. Avoid refactoring or restructuring.
3. Keep output and touched files minimal.
